components.name: Command line
components.purpose: Routes each typed coyodex command to the tool that runs it. The same layer decides how much of a long finding list a reader sees.

components.name: Map checks
components.purpose: Reads a finished map and reports where it contradicts itself. The same family flags a code link pointing at a line that cannot act.

components.name: Grounding record
components.purpose: Turns the skeptics' verdict files into the map's honesty record. The four counts a gate blocks on are derived, never hand-tallied.

components.name: Map editor
components.purpose: Applies one mechanical correction to a stored map in place. An edit matching no row, or more than one, is refused rather than guessed.

components.name: Map reader
components.purpose: Reads a map and never changes it. Three answers: one element's stored record, what two maps differ on, and the evidence behind a claim.

components.name: Build closer
components.purpose: Runs a build's closing steps in order and stops at the first failure. The last step writes one pre-commit verdict to a file.

components.name: Build briefing
components.purpose: Says which files a build will read and which commit its map will name. A second command prints the exact brief each helper agent is sent.

components.name: Build log
components.purpose: Records which session built a map, and when. Beside that it records how long each slice of the build took.

entry_points.trigger: An operator runs `coyodex ship` to run a build's whole closing sequence as one step.
An operator runs `coyodex preindex` to build the structural pre-index a map build starts from.
An operator runs `coyodex validate` to check that a map is well formed.
An operator runs `coyodex audit` to find where a map contradicts itself.
An operator runs `coyodex contract` to print the exact brief one helper agent should receive.
An operator runs `coyodex render` to write the map's committed markdown view.
An operator runs `coyodex serve` to open the viewer for a map in a browser.
An operator runs `coyodex assemble` to merge the build agents' fragments into one map.
A build agent runs `coyodex lint-fragment` to self-check one fragment before returning it.
An operator runs `coyodex anchor-drift` to find code links that point at the wrong line.
An operator runs `coyodex grounding lint` to check the skeptics' verdict files are well formed.
An operator runs `coyodex grounding write` to build the map's honesty record from the verdicts.
An operator runs `coyodex grounding report` to see which claims were refuted, tied or unvoted.
An operator runs `coyodex grounding by-element` to see what the review pass decided about each element.
An operator runs `coyodex grounding refutations` to fail a map still holding a claim the skeptics refuted.
An operator runs `coyodex fix apply-drift` to write each corrected code link back into the map.
An operator runs `coyodex fix drop-edge` to remove an arrow the skeptics refuted.
An operator runs `coyodex fix dedup-relation` to drop one of two records of the same data link.
An operator runs `coyodex fix dedup-edge` to keep one code link where an arrow was recorded twice.
An operator runs `coyodex fix security-row` to rewrite a refuted guard's wording and code link.
An operator runs `coyodex fix rows` to apply many wording corrections in one all-or-nothing write.
An operator runs `coyodex fix dedup-security` to drop a guard an older map recorded twice.
An operator runs `coyodex fix row` to rewrite one row's wording in the fragment that authored it.
An operator runs `coyodex provenance stamp` to record which session built this map, and when.
An operator runs `coyodex provenance show` to list the sessions that built this map.
A skeptic runs `coyodex context` to get one claims batch with its evidence already beside it.
An operator runs `coyodex timings record` to write down what each fan-out slice took.
An operator runs `coyodex timings order` to see one phase's slices, longest first.
An operator runs `coyodex timings show` to see every phase that has a timing record.
An operator runs `coyodex record` to note one advisory they judged acceptable.
An operator runs `coyodex diff` to see which rows two maps of the same work differ on.
An operator runs `coyodex dump` to read the map, or one element's stored record, as data.
An operator runs `coyodex reconcile` to expand the path rules into an explicit assignment file.
An operator runs `coyodex finalize` to get one pre-commit verdict over every check.
An operator runs `coyodex scope` to see which files a build will read before it starts.
An operator runs `coyodex balance` to see which diagrams hold too many boxes.

config.purpose: Says which folder the method and its agent brief templates are read from.
Names the session that gets stamped as the builder of this map.
config.default: nothing, so stamping refuses until a session name is passed by hand
